# Hirsel

> Hirsel is a zero-GC native systems programming language with explicit capabilities, bounded memory and steps, deterministic runtime execution, and recorded replay.

**Authority rule:** Always run `hirsel primer` from your installed binary as the exact authority for your installed version. Use `hirsel explain RULE` for any diagnostic rule ID and `hirsel inspect --core --interface` / `hirsel inspect --std --interface` for exact function signatures. Repository docs track `main`.

## Quick start

```sh
curl -fsSL https://hirsel.ai/install.sh | sh   # Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.28+); Apple Silicon macOS in progress
hirsel new app && cd app
hirsel check
hirsel test
hirsel run
```

## Docs

- [Primer](https://hirsel.ai/primer.md): whole language in one page — syntax, ownership, capabilities, budgets, and the CLI loop
- [Cookbook](https://hirsel.ai/cookbook.md): tested task-shaped recipes (CLI, files, HTTP router, Store, tasks/units, `sim` testing & laws, `Inline`/`Simd`)
- [Standard library index](https://hirsel.ai/api-index.md): every `std` module and its operations
- [Specification reference](https://hirsel.ai/docs/spec/): normative chapters for syntax, ownership, memory, budgets, capabilities, CLI, packages, and protocols
- [Benchmarks](https://hirsel.ai/benchmarks/): goal-board results, losing rows, and methodology
- [Full agent bundle (llms-full.txt)](https://hirsel.ai/llms-full.txt): single-file bundle containing intro, primer, cookbook, std API index, and agent skill
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/skills/hirsel/SKILL.md): iterative check/explain/inspect workflow for coding agents
- [Install script](https://hirsel.ai/install.sh): Linux x86_64 release installer

## Toolchain packages

Seventeen packages ship with the Hirsel toolchain (`std` plus the sixteen packages in
`core-packages/`) and bind by major version in `hirsel.toml`:

```text
[dependencies]
std = { major = 1 }
store = { major = 1 }
runner = { major = 1 }
```

- [std](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/std/API-INDEX.md) — standard library: files, directories, HTTP server/client, router, JSON, codecs, simulation (`std.sim`), property testing (`std.prop`), and crypto.
- [store](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/store/) — copy-on-write B+tree durable store: typed tables, secondary/unique/aggregate indexes, TTL expiry, projections, transactions, snapshots, and replay.
- [runner](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/runner/) — durable calls, live diff subscriptions, Rooms, TypeScript SDK generation ([sdk/client/README.md](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/sdk/client/README.md)), and place hosting.
- [platform](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/platform/) — deployed place management, cutovers, and recovery.
- [search](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/search/) — BM25 full-text search over a `store` table, callable from a transaction.
- [mcp](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/mcp/) — Model Context Protocol client and server over Streamable HTTP.
- Real-time media and networking (**pure Hirsel, no `Foreign` code**): [webrtc_sfu](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/webrtc_sfu/) (WebRTC SFU with simulcast, VP9/AV1 SVC, dynacast, Opus RED, and E2EE routing), [dtls](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/dtls/) (sans-IO DTLS 1.2), [srtp](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/srtp/) (SRTP/SRTCP), [rtp](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/rtp/) (RTP/RTCP, RTX, BWE, pacing, RED), [rtp_jitter](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/rtp_jitter/) (jitter buffer), [turn](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/turn/) (TURN client/relay), [stun_ice](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/stun_ice/) (STUN and ICE-lite), [sframe](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/sframe/) (RFC 9605 SFrame E2EE), [media_bits](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/media_bits/) (codec bitstream parsers), [media_container](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/media_container/) (Ogg/MP4/WebM containers), and [media_record](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/media_record/) (room publication recorder).

## Built on top, in Hirsel

Additional first-party packages in this repository (bind locally with `path = "..."` in
`[dependencies]`):

**Pure Hirsel libraries (no `Foreign` code):**

- [video_packager](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/video_packager/) — CMAF, HLS, and DASH media packaging.
- [image_core](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/image_core/) — image probing, transforms, and PNG, QOI, GIF, and AVIF codecs.
- [vector](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/vector/) — exact top-k nearest neighbours over a `store` table, read from a transaction.
- [spatial](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/spatial/) — Hilbert-curve spatial indexing over a `store` table.
- [postgres](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/postgres/) — PostgreSQL client with TLS and streaming query results.
- [jwtbind](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/jwtbind/) — JWT verification and runner caller binding.
- [toml](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/toml/) — TOML parser and serializer.
- [yaml](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/yaml/) — YAML parser and serializer.
- [archive](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/archive/) — tar (ustar/pax) and zip archive reader and writer with explicit safety limits.
- [tz](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/tz/) — IANA time zones and instant/local-time conversion.
- [xml](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/xml/) — streaming and tree XML parser and UTF-8 serializer.

**Thin C FFI wrappers (`Foreign`):**

- [opus](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/opus/), [av1](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/av1/), [h264](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/h264/) — thin C FFI wrappers for Opus, AV1, and H.264 codecs (used with [video_yuv](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/video_yuv/), [video_thumb](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/video_thumb/), and [video_transcode](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/video_transcode/)).
- [image_jpeg](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/image_jpeg/), [image_webp](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/image_webp/) — thin C FFI wrappers for JPEG and WebP codecs (used with [image_pipeline](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/image_pipeline/)).
- [sqlite](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/sqlite/) — SQLite bindings with explicit `Foreign` capabilities.

**Applications:**

- [checkbox](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/checkbox/) — shared board of one million checkboxes.

The durable LLM agent harness and its notes example app live in their own repository,
[lash-hirsel](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/lash-hirsel), and build against an installed toolchain.

Internal verification harnesses and benchmarks (`m1`, `m2b`, `ffi_laws`, `store-crash`,
`observe`, `wire`, `omap`, `sha256`) also live under [core/programs/](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/tree/main/core/programs/) for
compiler and runtime testing.

## Runnable examples

Standalone recipes that work in any fresh project (`hirsel new app`) are in
[docs/COOKBOOK.md](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/docs/COOKBOOK.md).

Repository examples (run from a checkout of this repo):

- [Subscription cache](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/sdk/client/tests/subscription-cache.ts) reads a `store` row from a `runner` subscription, observes cache changes, and applies an optimistic edit ([run the SDK check](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/sdk/client/README.md#run-the-subscription-example)).
- [PostgreSQL](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/postgres/example.hirsel) reads a typed column and drains the cursor before reusing the connection.
- [SQLite](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/sqlite/example.hirsel) binds a customer ID and reads the total from an in-memory database.
- [MCP](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/mcp/example.hirsel) decodes a tool-list reply and reads the tool name.
- [Search](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/search/example.hirsel) declares search on a `store` table of recipes and queries it in the writing transaction for the published match.
- [JPEG](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/image_jpeg/vectors/example.hirsel), [WebP](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/image_webp/vectors/example.hirsel), [HLS](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/video_packager/example.hirsel), and [Opus](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/opus/vectors/example.hirsel) media codec and packaging examples.

Run the package examples from the repository root with the `hirsel` binary:

```sh
hirsel test core/programs/postgres --filter select_answer
hirsel test core/programs/sqlite --filter sum_orders --grant Foreign=sqlite@1/sqlite/Sqlite
hirsel test core/programs/mcp --filter read_tool_catalog
hirsel test core/programs/search --filter find_document
hirsel test core/programs/video_packager --filter hls_cmaf
```

The codec examples run with the [JPEG](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/image_jpeg/test-vectors.sh),
[WebP](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/image_webp/test-vectors.sh), and
[Opus](https://github.com/SamGalanakis/hirsel/blob/main/core/programs/opus/test-vectors.sh) vector scripts. Each script lists the
reference inputs it needs.
